description: Benchmark ADIRF sorting-signal scans against classically secreted, leaderless-UPS and classical-NLS control proteins; scan trafficking/EV-sorting motifs
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ADIRF="MASKGLQDLKQQVEGTAQEAVSAAGAAAQQVVDQATEAGQKAMDQLAKTTQETIDKTANQASDTFSGIGKKFGLLK"

# ---------------- benchmark panel with positive / negative controls ----------------
panel = {
 # classically secreted (signal peptide) -- positive control for the SP scan
 "ALB (albumin)":("P02768","classical secreted"),
 "INS (insulin)":("P01308","classical secreted"),
 "APOA1":("P02647","classical secreted"),
 "LEP (leptin)":("P41159","classical secreted"),
 "ADIPOQ (adiponectin)":("Q15848","classical secreted"),
 "CCL2":("P13500","classical secreted"),
 # leaderless / unconventionally secreted -- the comparison class in the hypothesis
 "FGF2":("P09038","leaderless UPS"),
 "IL1B":("P01584","leaderless UPS"),
 "HMGB1":("P09429","leaderless UPS"),
 "LGALS1":("P09382","leaderless UPS"),
 "LGALS3":("P17931","leaderless UPS"),
 "TXN (thioredoxin)":("P10599","leaderless UPS"),
 "MIF":("P14174","leaderless UPS"),
 "ANXA1":("P04083","leaderless UPS"),
 # nuclear proteins carrying a validated classical NLS -- positive control for the NLS scan
 "NPM1":("P06748","nuclear, classical NLS"),
 "TP53":("P04637","nuclear, classical NLS"),
 "NCL (nucleolin)":("P19338","nuclear, classical NLS"),
 "HNRNPA1":("P09651","nuclear, classical NLS"),
 "SRSF1":("Q07955","nuclear, classical NLS"),
}
seqs={"ADIRF":(ADIRF,"ADIRF (query)")}
for name,(acc,cls) in panel.items():
    j=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=60).json()
    seqs[name]=(j["sequence"]["value"],cls)
print("sequences retrieved:",len(seqs))

kd=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
mwt=dict(A=71.08,C=103.14,D=115.09,E=129.12,F=147.18,G=57.05,H=137.14,I=113.16,K=128.17,L=113.16,
M=131.19,N=114.10,P=97.12,Q=128.13,R=156.19,S=87.08,T=101.11,V=99.13,W=186.21,Y=163.18)
def h_region(s):   # best 8-residue hydrophobic stretch inside residues 2-30 (signal-peptide h-region)
    seg=s[1:31]; return max(np.mean([kd.get(a,0) for a in seg[i:i+8]]) for i in range(len(seg)-7))
def kd19(s): return max(np.mean([kd.get(a,0) for a in s[i:i+19]]) for i in range(len(s)-18))
def krmax(s): return max(sum(1 for a in s[i:i+6] if a in "KR") for i in range(len(s)-5))
def nls(s):  return bool(re.search(r"K[KR].[KR]|[KR]{2}.{9,12}[KR]{3,5}",s))
rows=[]
for n,(s,c) in seqs.items():
    rows.append(dict(protein=n, cls=c, L=len(s), kDa=round((sum(mwt.get(a,110) for a in s)+18)/1000,1),
        h_region=round(h_region(s),2), kd19max=round(kd19(s),2), maxKR6=krmax(s), classicalNLS=nls(s),
        nCys=s.count("C"), nTyr=s.count("Y"), nArg=s.count("R"),
        net=sum(1 for a in s if a in "KR")-sum(1 for a in s if a in "DE")))
bench=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== Benchmark: sorting-signal scans with positive and negative controls ===")
print(bench.to_string(index=False))
print("\nGroup means (h_region = signal-peptide hydrophobic-core score):")
print(bench.groupby("cls")[["h_region","kd19max","maxKR6"]].mean().round(2).to_string())
print("\nSeparation check: classical secreted h_region range %.2f-%.2f ; leaderless UPS range %.2f-%.2f ; ADIRF %.2f"%(
  bench[bench.cls=="classical secreted"].h_region.min(),bench[bench.cls=="classical secreted"].h_region.max(),
  bench[bench.cls=="leaderless UPS"].h_region.min(),bench[bench.cls=="leaderless UPS"].h_region.max(),
  bench[bench.protein=="ADIRF"].h_region.iloc[0]))
print("classical-NLS regex hit rate: nuclear controls %d/%d ; leaderless UPS %d/%d ; ADIRF %s"%(
  bench[bench.cls=="nuclear, classical NLS"].classicalNLS.sum(),(bench.cls=="nuclear, classical NLS").sum(),
  bench[bench.cls=="leaderless UPS"].classicalNLS.sum(),(bench.cls=="leaderless UPS").sum(),
  bench[bench.protein=="ADIRF"].classicalNLS.iloc[0]))

# ---------------- trafficking / sorting motif scan on ADIRF ----------------
print("\n=== Trafficking and EV-sorting motif scan on ADIRF ===")
motifs={
 "N-myristoylation (Met1-Gly2 + G-x-x-x-S/T)": r"^MG",
 "S-palmitoylation (any Cys)":                 r"C",
 "GPI omega-site proxy (C-term small-residue + hydrophobic tail)": None,
 "Tyrosine sorting YxxPhi":                    r"Y..[LIVFM]",
 "Dileucine [DE]xxxL[LI]":                     r"[DE]...L[LI]",
 "Acidic dileucine DxxLL":                     r"D..LL",
 "NPxY endocytic":                             r"N P.Y".replace(" ",""),
 "ER retention KDEL/HDEL":                     r"[KH]DEL$",
 "Peroxisomal PTS1 (S/A/C)(K/R/H)(L/M)$":      r"[SAC][KRH][LM]$",
 "Mitochondrial presequence proxy (R at -2/-3, amphipathic, no D/E in 1-20)": None,
 "Caveolin-binding Phi-x-x-x-x-Phi-x-x-Phi":   r"[WFY]....[WFY]..[WFY]",
 "TSG101/ESCRT PTAP late domain":              r"P[TS]AP",
 "ALIX-binding YPxL late domain":              r"YP.L",
 "NEDD4 PPxY late domain":                     r"PP.Y",
}
for n,p in motifs.items():
    if p is None: continue
    hits=[(m.start()+1,m.group()) for m in re.finditer(p,ADIRF)]
    print(f"  {n:58s}: {hits if hits else 'NONE'}")
print(f"  Mitochondrial presequence: residues 1-20 contain {sum(1 for a in ADIRF[:20] if a in 'DE')} acidic residue(s) "
      f"(D8, E14, E19) and {sum(1 for a in ADIRF[:20] if a=='R')} Arg -> incompatible with a cleavable matrix-targeting presequence")

# KFERQ-like (CMA / endosomal microautophagy -> EV loading) canonical Dice rule
def kferq(s):
    out=[]
    basics=set("KR"); acid=set("DE"); hyd=set("ILVF"); qn=set("QN")
    for i in range(len(s)-4):
        p=s[i:i+5]
        if not (p[0] in qn or p[4] in qn): continue
        core=p[1:] if p[0] in qn else p[:4]
        nb=sum(1 for a in core if a in basics); na=sum(1 for a in core if a in acid)
        nh=sum(1 for a in core if a in hyd)
        if 1<=nb<=2 and na==1 and 1<=nh<=2 and nb+na+nh==4:
            out.append((i+1,p))
    return out
print(f"  {'KFERQ-like motif (canonical Dice rule)':58s}: {kferq(ADIRF) if kferq(ADIRF) else 'NONE'}")
print(f"  Tyr count = {ADIRF.count('Y')}, Cys count = {ADIRF.count('C')}, Pro count = {ADIRF.count('P')}, "
      f"Arg count = {ADIRF.count('R')}  -> Y/C/P/R-dependent sorting signals are structurally impossible")

# FGF2-type Type-I UPS determinants
print("\n=== FGF2-type (Type I, PI(4,5)P2-dependent pore) determinants ===")
fgf2=seqs["FGF2"][0]
def basicpatch(s,w=12): return max(sum(1 for a in s[i:i+w] if a in "KR") for i in range(len(s)-w+1))
for n in ["FGF2","IL1B","ADIRF"]:
    s=seqs[n][0] if n!="ADIRF" else ADIRF
    print(f"  {n:6s}: net charge {sum(1 for a in s if a in 'KR')-sum(1 for a in s if a in 'DE'):+4d} | "
          f"max K/R in 12-mer (PI(4,5)P2 patch) {basicpatch(s):2d} | Cys {s.count('C')}")
bench.to_csv("/agent/jobs/7101df4b-f637-4c64-a448-cb0dfb4eb46e/provenance/adirf_signal_benchmark.csv",index=False)

# ---------------- figure ----------------
order=["classical secreted","leaderless UPS","nuclear, classical NLS","ADIRF (query)"]
cols={"classical secreted":"#2b6cb0","leaderless UPS":"#2f855a","nuclear, classical NLS":"#805ad5","ADIRF (query)":"#dd6b20"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.5))
for i,c in enumerate(order):
    sub=bench[bench.cls==c]
    ax[0].scatter(np.full(len(sub),i)+np.random.default_rng(0).normal(0,.06,len(sub)),sub.h_region,
                  s=90,color=cols[c],edgecolor='k',linewidth=.5,zorder=3)
ax[0].axhline(1.6,ls='--',c='#c53030'); ax[0].text(-0.4,1.65,'signal-peptide h-region threshold',c='#c53030',fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(4)); ax[0].set_xticklabels([o.replace(", ",",\n").replace(" UPS","\nUPS").replace(" secreted","\nsecreted") for o in order],fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel('best 8-residue hydrophobic-core score in residues 2-30')
ax[0].set_title('Signal-peptide scan: ADIRF scores with the\nleaderless proteins, far below secreted controls',fontsize=11)
ax[0].annotate('ADIRF = 0.70',xy=(3,0.70),xytext=(2.2,-0.4),fontsize=9,arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax[0].grid(alpha=.25,axis='y')
for i,c in enumerate(order):
    sub=bench[bench.cls==c]
    ax[1].scatter(np.full(len(sub),i)+np.random.default_rng(1).normal(0,.06,len(sub)),sub.maxKR6,
                  s=90,color=cols[c],edgecolor='k',linewidth=.5,zorder=3)
ax[1].axhline(4,ls='--',c='#c53030'); ax[1].text(-0.4,4.08,'minimum for a classical monopartite NLS',c='#c53030',fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xticks(range(4)); ax[1].set_xticklabels([o.replace(", ",",\n").replace(" UPS","\nUPS").replace(" secreted","\nsecreted") for o in order],fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel('maximum K/R count in any 6-residue window')
ax[1].set_title('NLS scan: ADIRF reaches 2 basic residues,\nnuclear controls reach 4-6',fontsize=11)
ax[1].annotate('ADIRF = 2',xy=(3,2),xytext=(2.1,0.6),fontsize=9,arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax[1].grid(alpha=.25,axis='y')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
